# BBC

> BBC is a global news and media organization providing breaking news, live coverage, sports, business, technology, culture, and entertainment content across multiple platforms.

BBC.com serves as the primary digital hub for the British Broadcasting Corporation, offering comprehensive coverage of world news, UK politics, sports, and cultural content. The site features live news channels, podcasts, video documentaries, and specialized sections covering business, technology, health, travel, and environmental issues.

## Key Topics

- Breaking News
- Live Coverage
- World News
- UK News
- US Politics
- Sport
- Technology & AI
- Business & Markets
- Documentaries
- Iran Conflict
- Geopolitics
- Climate & Environment
- Culture & Arts
- Radio & Podcasts
- Video Journalism

## News & Live Coverage

- [BBC Home](https://www.bbc.com/home): BBC home portal with news, sport, weather and TV/radio highlights
- [BBC News](https://www.bbc.com/news): BBC News hub with breaking news, world, US, UK coverage and analysis
- [BBC Live & Breaking News](https://www.bbc.com/live): BBC Live coverage of breaking world and US news with live updates
- [BBC News Channel - Watch Live](https://www.bbc.com/watch-live-news): 24-hour live breaking news coverage from BBC News channel worldwide
- [US & Canada News](https://www.bbc.com/news/us-canada): BBC News coverage of US and Canada politics, conflicts and regional updates
- [UK News](https://www.bbc.com/news/uk): BBC UK news hub with breaking news, politics, crime and regional coverage
- [Politics](https://www.bbc.com/news/politics): BBC Politics news on UK elections, government policy and political analysis
- [England Regional News](https://www.bbc.com/news/england): BBC England regional news with breaking updates and local coverage

## Sports & Entertainment

- [BBC Sport](https://www.bbc.com/sport): BBC Sport coverage including football, F1, cricket, rugby and live scores
- [BBC Culture](https://www.bbc.com/culture): BBC Culture with film, TV reviews, books, music and entertainment news
- [BBC Arts](https://www.bbc.com/arts): BBC Arts coverage of theatre, opera, visual art and classical music
- [BBC Travel](https://www.bbc.com/travel): BBC Travel guides covering destinations, food culture and travel experiences

## Business, Technology & Innovation

- [BBC Business](https://www.bbc.com/business): BBC Business news covering economy, tech, AI, finance and market updates
- [BBC Technology](https://www.bbc.com/technology): BBC Technology news on AI, consumer tech, gadgets and innovation
- [BBC Health](https://www.bbc.com/health): BBC Health hub covering nutrition, wellness, mental health and longevity
- [BBC Earth](https://www.bbc.com/future-planet): BBC Earth on climate change, environment, conservation and sustainability

## Video, Audio & Documentaries

- [BBC Video](https://www.bbc.com/video): BBC Video journalism and award-winning documentary storytelling
- [BBC Documentaries](https://www.bbc.com/video/docs): BBC award-winning documentaries on history, nature and true crime
- [BBC Audio](https://www.bbc.com/audio): BBC Audio hub with radio stations, podcasts and audio content

## Homepage & Navigation

- [BBC Homepage](https://www.bbc.com): BBC homepage with breaking news, world news, sports, business, climate, culture and travel
